title: Gokurakugai
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Gokurakugai, a lawless district, the duo Tao and Alma run a troubleshooting agency that takes on requests from residents, especially cases involving Mahoro, monstrous demons that prey on people while disguised among them (to verify).
life_message: It holds up helping neighbors in a hard place and loyalty between partners.
